id: title:Gilbert09:show manual webhook setup instead of a failing create button

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the WebhookSetupForm component to show a warning and retry option when automatic setup fails, potentially aiding user recovery from temporary failures.
review.reason: The implementation in P1.F2.H1 adds a webhookUrlMissing check and conditional rendering of a warning banner and retry button. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement: it allows users to recover from temporary webhook setup failures regardless of the source type. P1.F1.H2 is test-only and P1.F3.H1 is backend configuration, neither contributing to the tier. No P
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the webhook setup failure being a recoverable transient state rather than a permanent configuration error; this is not verified by the code. No adoption or incident avoidance is demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains four hunks. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H2 are test-only changes; P1.F3.H1 is backend configuration. P1.F2.H1 is the implementation. No tier assignment is made here.

observations.behavior: Adds webhookResult parameter and its usage in the renderFallback helper, passing the result to the form.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows tests to supply a webhook result object to the form, including webhook_url and error, without relying on the component's default behavior.

observations.behavior: Adds webhookUrlMissing check and conditional rendering of warning banner and retry button, including conditional text for manual-only sources.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the WebhookSetupForm component to show a warning and retry option even when automatic setup fails, regardless of whether the source is manual-only or not. This could help users recover from temporary failures.
